ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি - লং কোর্স.exp:
Question: A sum of money amounts to Tk. 15000 in 4 years at 25% simple interest per annum. Find the sum.

Solution:
Given,
A = 15000
T = 4
R = 25%

We know,
SI = P × R × T
= P × (25/100) × 4
= P

A = P + SI
⇒ A = P + P
⇒ A = 2P
⇒ 15000 = 2P
⇒ P = 15000/2
∴ P = 7500

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি - লং কোর্স.exp:
Question: Some principal becomes Tk. 1,560 as profit-principal in 3 years and Tk. 1,920 as profit-principal in 6 years. Find the rate of profit.

Solution: 
Given,
Principal + Profit for 3 years = 1560
Principal + Profit for 6 years = 1920

So the profit of 3 years I = Tk. (1920 - 1560)
= Tk. 360

So the principal P = Tk. (1560 - 360)
= Tk. 1200

∴ The rate of profit r = (I × 100)/(P × n)
= (360 × 100)/(1200 × 3)
= 10

Solution:

P = Tk. 100
Then, S.I = Tk. 75
and n = 5 years

So the rate r = (100 × 75)/(100 × 5)
= 15%

Now, P = Tk. 16,000
n = 2 years
r = 15% p.a.
= 3/20 p.a

C.I = 16,000 × {(1 + 3/20)2 - 1}
= 16,000 × {(23/20)2 - 1}

Question: Mr. Sohan is planning to buy a mobile after two years time from now. He expects that after two years he will need Tk. 18150 to buy the mobile. How much money does Mr. Sohan need to invest now at 10% interest rate compounded annually?

Solution:
Given,
Compounded Amount = Tk. 18150
Time n = 2 years
Rate r = 10% = 10/100 = 1/10

We know,
Compounded Amount = P(1 + r)n
⇒ 18150 = P(1 +1/10)2
⇒ 18150 = P(11/10)2
⇒ 18150 =121P/100
⇒ 121P =18150 × 100
⇒ P =1815000 ÷ 121
∴ P = 15000

Question: The compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 12% per annum is Tk. 795. The simple interest on the same sum for double the time at half the rate percent per annum is-

Solution: 
Let
The sum be Tk. P

ATQ,
P{1 + (12/100)}2 - P = 795
⇒ P[{1 + (3/25)}2 - 1] = 795
⇒ P{(28/25)2 - 1} = 795
⇒  P{(784/625) - 1} = 795
⇒  P(159/625) = 795
⇒ P = (795 × 625)/159
∴ P = 3125

So The simple interest on the same sum for double the time at half the rate percent per annum is-

Question: A person borrows Rs. 5000 for 2 years at 4% p.a. simple interest. He immediately lends it to another person at 6% p.a compound interest for 2 years. Find his total gain in the transaction.

Solution:
Given,
P = Tk. 5000
n = 2 years
r = 4% = 4/100 = 1/25

So the simple interest = 5000 × (1/25) × 2
= Tk. 400

Again,
compound interest rate r = 6% = 6/100 = 3/50

So,
The compound interest = P(1 + r)n - P
= 5000(1 + 3/50)2 - 5000
= {5000 × (53/50)2} - 5000
= (5000 × 2809/2500) - 5000
= 5618 - 5000
= 618

So the total gain in the transaction = (618 - 400)
= Tk. 218

Question: A sum of money on compound interest amounts to Tk. 13200 in 3 years and Tk. 12000 in 2 years. The rate of interest per annum is?

Solution:
Let,
Sum = Tk. P
Rate = r% = r/100

ATQ,
P(1 + r/100)2 = 12000............(1)
P(1 + r/100)3 = 13200.........(2)

Dividing equation (2) by (1):
1 + r/100 = 13200/12000
⇒ (100 + r)/100 = 11/10
⇒ 100 +r = (11 × 100)/10
⇒ 100 +r = 110
⇒ r = 110 - 100
∴ r = 10

If the total amount of simple interest earned in 3 years be Tk. 558, what was the amount invested in Scheme Y?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি - লং কোর্স.exp:
Question: Mr. Rony invested an amount of Tk. 1800 divided in two different schemes X and Y at the simple interest rate of 12% p.a. and 10% p.a. respectively. If the total amount of simple interest earned in 3 years be Tk. 558, what was the amount invested in Scheme Y?

Solution:
Let,
The amount invested in Scheme X = Tk. a
Then, the amount invested in Scheme Y = Tk. (1800 - a)

So the interest of X schemes =Tk. {a × (12/100) × 3}
= 9a/25
So the interest of Y schemes =Tk. {(1800- a) × (10/100) × 3}
= 540 - (3a/10)

ATQ,
(9a/25) + 540 - (3a/10) = 558
⇒ 9a/25 - 3a/10 = 558 - 540
⇒ (18a - 15a)/50 = 18
⇒ 3a/50 = 18
⇒ 3a = 18 × 50
⇒ 3a = 900
∴ a = 300

Amount in Scheme Y = Tk. (1800 - 300)
= Tk. 1500

Question: Find the compound interest on Tk. 2,000 at the rate of 20% per annum for 18 months when interest is compounded half yearly?

Solution: 
Given that,
principal P = Tk. 2,000
Compound rate, r = 20% per annum = 20%/2 half-yearly = 10% half-yearly
Time 18 month = 3 half-years

Amount,
C = P{1 + (r/100)}n
= 2,000{1 + (10/100)}3

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি - লং কোর্স.question: ২৪) The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 5% per annum, compounded annually, is Tk. 25. What is the principal (sum)?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি - লং কোর্স.exp:
Question: The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 5% per annum, compounded annually, is Tk. 25. What is the principal (sum)?

Solution: 
Let,
The principal = P

So the simple interest(SI) = Prn
= P × 5% × 2
= P × 5/100 × 2
= P/10

So the compound interest(CI) = P(1 +r)n - P
= P{(1 + 5/100)2 - 1}
= P{(21/20)2 - 1}
= P{441/400 - 1}
= P{(441 - 400)/400}
= 41P/400

ATQ,
(41P/400) - (P/10) = 25
⇒ (41P - 40P)/400 = 25
⇒ P/400 = 25
⇒ P = 25 × 400
∴ P = 10000

Question: If in a certain language PROPOSE is coded as PPONOQE, how is MENTORS coded in that code?

Solution:
In the given code
PROPOSE = PPONOQE

The 1st, 3rd 5th and 7th letters are same but in the place of 2nd, 4th and 6th letters previous two letters are used.
So,
MENTORS = MCNROPS
